title: “Jesus talked about hell more than we do.”
paragraphs: “Jesus talked about hell more than we do.”

The same Jesus who said,
“Love your enemies”
also said,
“Fear Him who can destroy both soul and body.”
Or would it stay silent to stay comfortable?
Is hell literal… metaphorical… or misunderstood?

Either way —
He didn’t whisper about it.

Before debating others — ask yourself:
Do I take His warnings as seriously as His comfort?
